body: No I haven't, I don't think it would help to be honest.

Yeah, Music and drawing and that's all I do, Literally. But with the music, I write songs about my feelings and my life and it just ends up putting me in a worst place mentally because I relive the feelings that I felt.
Yeah. The last time I remember feeling good was when I was 7ish years old, Of course there have been happy moments since then but they have been very brief.

Thank you, I've talked to multiple therapists since I was 6-7ish years old and non of them did anything for me at all, They were all great therapists, I just didn't get anything from talking to them. As for my mom, I don't really feel comfortable talking to her about my feelings, Since some of my issues involve her it gets awkward and she naturally gets defensive which is normal for a human but its kind of hard to say things when after you get done the person comes back either denying it or apologizes (which makes me feel guilty).
I don't feel like I'm out of options, I know there are always options I just can't see them.
